reasons.text: 100% all-in to 100bb preserves AA as the premium value anchor. All entries describe supplied AI estimates, not GTO or solver results: CO's disjoint call/four-bet supports make joint reach zero, so strategic explanations are counterfactual, not validated opponent-conditioned conclusions.

reasons.text: 100% call to 26bb retains AKs's high-card strength and nut-flush potential for another 13bb, closing action without committing 100bb. Its ace and king remove both strong and weaker SB holdings; this does not prove a shove.
